title: behaviorFacts
responsibility: Formats duration and ordered scenario outcomes for Reports and Desktop.

inputs.name: behaviorFacts.duration
inputs.description: Required duration text, or null for Not measured; zero-duration text is retained.

inputs.name: behaviorFacts.scenarios
inputs.description: Required ordered scenario records; numeric array access preserves custom iterator and species admission.

inputs.name: behaviorFacts.paired
inputs.description: Required comparison flag; true includes the parent outcome and arrow.

inputs.name: behaviorFacts.options
inputs.description: Optional display settings, default {}; durationLabel defaults to E2E duration and highlight defaults to false.

outputs.name: behaviorFacts
outputs.description: Duration followed by scenario facts, with stable keys, labels, literal outcomes and optional status classes.

errors.name: Input access error
errors.description: Errors from supplied property getters propagate without cloning, serializing or replacing the input.
